issues.issue: Under the receipt category rules, interest lines go to 'Interest Income'. 'investment income' is only for dividends, gains, or lines labelled investment income/earnings.

issues.resolution: fixed 2026-10-27: governmental lines from the Statement of Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3), Total column; fund balance by classification (8 Restricted, 2 Committed, Unassigned); totals 1,144,832 unchanged

issues.on_page: Statement of Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3), Total Governmental Funds: Restricted lines; Committed to Road maintenance 138,727, Emergency bridge 24,670; Unassigned 733,522; total 1,144,832
issues.issue: Under the 2026-10-27 balance-sheet rule, a cash-basis report whose governmental funds statement totals match the government-wide figures (1,144,832 on both) takes its lines from the governmental funds statement, with fund balance by classification. issues.resolution: fixed 2026-10-27: Noxious Weed detail line category natural resources/conservation
issues.issue: The disbursement category rules explicitly put noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation, and Fillmore County's noxious weed line uses that category.

issues.issue: The split uses government-wide amounts from p2. It ties only because all property and motor vehicle tax sits in the General Fund, and the budget schedule doesn't print the split. Putting the whole Taxes budget on the property line is also an assumption.

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities: Charges for services 43,183, Interest income 58,593, Miscellaneous 30,964
